scientific_question: Do eleven reviewed studies including evolved linked multifunction RNA demonstrate transmitted beneficial function in autonomously sustained complete synthetic-cell offspring, without investigator commanded reproductive reconstruction? No such integrated unassisted lineage established.
source_independence: Eleven primary sources in seven programs: four shared Boekhoven, two shared Kurihara/Sugawara vesicle sources, one each Fletcher, Otto, Minnesota/Adamala preprint, Danelon/Toulouse, and Ichihashi/Mizuuchi cooperative RNA. Historical Furubayashi 2020 is same RNA program catalog context, not a second independent validation.
